draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.19, the 95th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 13th of 36 at CB. He went 72nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Emmanuel Moseley. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 3 passes defended in 2022, 33rd of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Arizona Cardinals. 35 career games and 27 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 4 in 2024. Weak spots: completion % allowed 80.0% (2nd percentile), passer rating allowed 129.2 (2nd percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 48.2% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, above the norm.
